local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original chair course')
 assert(self.cell.name=='ChorrolCastleGreatHall','Original chair course left Great Hall')
 local throne=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x02b1f5))
 assert(throne and throne:isValid(),'Original throne missing')
 local nearest=math.huge
 for _,actor in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if actor:isValid() and actor.recordId~=self.recordId then local d=actor.position-throne.position;nearest=math.min(nearest,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)) end
 end
 assert(nearest>60,'Positive empty-throne course became occupied')
 print('ThroneSeat context nearestActor='..nearest)
 local mode=camera.getMode()
 print('ThroneSeat alive position='..tostring(self.position))
 print('ThroneSeatView first='..tostring(mode==camera.MODE.FirstPerson)..' third='..tostring(mode==camera.MODE.ThirdPerson))
end}}}}
